subject: factor levels dropped in fill legend?

messages.author: 43168fb1dc939702
messages.subject: factor levels dropped in fill legend?
parts:
I am plotting barplots, filled with a factor. The factor has no observations for one of the levels, so that level is dropped. But for comparison with other graphics, I would like to keep all the levels. (See code below.) Tried '+ scale_fill_discrete(fill = TRUE)', and no luck. 

Clearly I am missing something obvious, but I have been trying without luck for several hours now... Hopefully someone can help me?

Thanks,
Sarah

n <- 100
dat <- data.frame(x = rbinom(n, 3, 0.5), 
                  x2 = rbinom(n, 3, 0.5), 
                  y= rnorm(n))
dat$x2[dat$x2 == 3] <- 2
dat$x[dat$x == 1] <- 0
dat$x <- factor(dat$x, 0:3, LETTERS[1:4])
dat$x2 <- factor(dat$x2, 0:3, LETTERS[5:8])

str(dat)
with(dat, table(x, x2))

# x scale works ok...
qplot(x, y, data = dat, geom = "boxplot", color = x) + scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)
qplot(x2, y, data = dat, geom = "boxplot", color = x2) + scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

# fill scale does not!
pfill <- qplot(x, data = dat, fill = x2)
pfill

pfill + scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) + scale_fill_discrete(drop = FALSE) # ok for x, not x2!
